subject: FWL status: 6.1% long-doc perplexity gain, JAX gradient bug
body:
Hi Bruno,

Status. Both implementations are running. The fast weight block is as described — dense projection to 4x size, squared ReLU, projection back to size, layer norm — and on our 4096-token eval set, attn_chunks at 16 for the mixed chunk attention is clearly right; 4 loses most of the long-range benefit.

Results: FWLs cut long-document perplexity by 6.1% over the frozen baseline, in the same band as dynamic evaluation in our replication, at roughly 8x less inference-time cost.

The bad news: I found a gradient bug in the JAX path (the flax.linen one, which the release itself flags as lightly tested) — fast weights fail to update after the first chunk. Fix is understood but eats a week.

Gustavo
